# Facebook Events Scraper

The Apify actor [`apify/facebook-events-scraper`](https://apify.com/apify/facebook-events-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.93**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Facebook Events Scraper extracts data such as event name, location, description or number of users who are interested. You can use URLs of specific events or come up with search queries and explore pretty much unlimited number of events. Search queries can be combined with various search filters.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Event $0.013, Actor start $0.001 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/facebook-events-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-facebook-events-scraper@0.0.93#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs: {}
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Input

Only these fields are accepted — `telo check` rejects any other.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `searchQueries` | array |  | `[]` | Search (What and/or where) — Search you want to use to discover new events. You can provide search for topics, such as 'Sport', or for places, such as 'New York', or combine them 'Sport New York'. |
| `startUrls` | array |  | `[]` | Or use direct URLs instead of Search — URLs to start with. You can provide URLs of event details here or search/explore URLs, e.g. 'https://www.facebook.com/events/1023978871819924' or 'https://www.facebook.com/events/search/?q=Party' or 'https://www.facebook.com/events/explore/fr-paris/110774245616 |
| `maxEvents` | integer |  |  | Max Events — Maximum number of events to extract for each search query or start URL. If you leave this field empty, the number of events won't be limited. |
